They are being gently held or framed by human fingers from above. The hamster on the left is facing downwards/left, displaying golden-brown and white fur. The hamster on the right is facing downwards/right, displaying darker brown/grey fur. Both appear to be eating or investigating something on the surface. A colorful patterned object is visible in the top-left background.

The ear of the left hamster is visible, appearing small, rounded, and furry, fitting the 'relatively large' description compared to the tiny eye, though typical for dwarf hamsters.
